lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wow, we sure explored a lot.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Should we check out one last thing before we finish?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We've been going to places that we want this entire time,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: so you choose this time, Teacher.
There is a place I've been dying to go to.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wouldn't us going there be a bit disruptive?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: After all, we're all qualified marksmen here.
That's exactly why I want to go.
Isn't it super cool that this school is has a shooting range booth?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Now that you mention it, it is pretty intriguing.
We enter the shooting range set up inside a large shipping container.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Wow! I really look up to you!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I've always wanted to meet you in person.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: W-well, since you're here, would you like to play a round?

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: You see that big ball at the end over there?

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: If you break the ball within five shots using this launcher, you win.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: I-it's fine. It's just a toy gun.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: Hehe, that's because it's made for Nikkes.
A toy gun... made for Nikkes?
As an enormous explosion rings out, Privaty clings to me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That explosion is way too big for that to be a toy weapon!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What if civilians end up being injured?

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: This cargo container was specially built to contain the explosions.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: They said we could blow up as many things as we wanted.
Indeed, aside from the loud sound, there doesn't seem to be any visible damage anywhere.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: A shooting range can be both thrilling and a stress reliever.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: They said I was the perfect one for the job, so they invited me out here.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: Would you like to give it a try, Privaty?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Can that ball even be destroyed?

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: I can break it in one shot, hehe.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The launcher isn't easy to use, that's all.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: The more you learn about it, the more fascinating it gets.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Was it really necessary to make it this realistic?
How long are you planning to stay in this position?
Privaty is holding onto me tightly as she watches Zwei fire away.
Actually, rather than holding onto me,
it's more than her entire body is wrapped around me, my head included.
It feels nice, but it's also a bit awkward.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'd like to try! Give me the launcher!

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: You got it in two shots!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thrilling and a great stress reliever, huh?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'd say you were spot on.

lines.speaker: vesti_s
lines.text: It's an explosion-shaped plush toy, hehe.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That was seriously impressive, Miss Privaty.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Breaking the ball in two shots was cool,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: but the way you clung to Teacher and guarded him was the ultimate.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: When I graduate, I'll become a commander and protect someone with my whole body too.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I don't think that will work, you're too small for that.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: No way! I don't even have to see that to know how boring it is.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I think it'd be fun too.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: You're a third-year now, Ein. It's about time you show an interest in this sort of thing.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: As a teacher, I'd love to see that.
We enter a huge building specially prepared for the job experience area.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Why did they make it so big?

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: It's always nice to see a familiar face.

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: I was invited as a flight attendant for the career experience booth.

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: Is anyone interested in flying through the sky?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I'm interested, but how often do people actually fly?

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: It's precisely because it's so rare that it's so special! ★
to a huge life-sized model airplane.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's my first time seeing an airplane in person.

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: This is where we're holding our special event.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What do we have to do?

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: Follow me, grab onto the airplane window, and hang outside.
A tremendous gust of wind suddenly blows,
and Privaty pulls me into her arms.
I wrap my arms around Privaty's waist.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I-I feel like I'm gonna fly away!

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: If you can hold out for three minutes, there's a special gift in it for you! ♥

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What does this have to do with practical job experience, Sora?

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: It's about how to respond when an accident happens during a flight! ♡

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: You must withstand the wind until you're able to land safely ★

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's a bit of a stretch...

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: I assure you, once you experience it, this will prove helpful in many ways! ☆

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: So don't stick too close to the Captain,

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: and you try it for yourself, Privaty!
Privaty is still holding onto me.
And I'm holding onto her waist.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The wind was too strong! That's all!
Urgh... the wind... it's too strong...!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Yeah, everything was spinning for a while, but I'm okay now.

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: I'll turn up the wind speed a bit more.
Privaty ultimately succeeds in lasting for three minutes,
and receives the gift Sora mentioned.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The wind really cleared my head.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But surely you don't do events like this for ordinary civilians?

lines.speaker: sora_s
lines.text: We offer them a perfectly normal aviation experience ★

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: *Sigh* I feel like I've been tricked somehow.
Your hair is a bit messy now, Miss Privaty.
I tidy up Privaty's disheveled hair.
By the time we're done enjoying the flurry of events and head outside,

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I can't believe it's already this late,

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: and today is the last day of the festival.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We had so much fun. I'm kinda sad to see it end.
The school is still packed with people,
and everyone is smiling, without exception.
Yeah, you were feeling pretty pressured in a lot of ways

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: So much so I wish that time would stop.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I can't believe we have to return to everyday life.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But since I've learned how to enjoy it, I think I'll be able to handle it better than I expected.
Amy is smiling, just like everyone else.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We should head back to the classroom and clean up.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We need to take down all the decorations and put the desks back.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You two should relax and enjoy yourselves.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Come on, it's way too obvious!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You two are head over heels for each other.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I've even been trying to steer things in the right direction.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Anyway, don't worry about the classroom. We'll handle it.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm an upperclassman now, I'll keep an eye on things.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: This is something we got earlier at the haunted house.
Huh? Why are you giving me this...?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I don't really know why I was given this either... But I feel like you will need it more right now.
Ein hands me the small box.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: There are gonna be fireworks in about thirty minutes.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Have a nice time, you two!
The rest of the students walks away,
and only Privaty and I remain.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I wonder what they're up to...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Well, is there anywhere you want to go?
It would be nice to be somewhere alone.
Yeah, that place is the best.
Why don't we go up to the rooftop?
I hold out my hand to Privaty,
and she takes it without hesitation.
Most of the school has been decorated, so there probably isn't anywhere we can really go.
But the teachers' office should be unaffected.
Privaty would feel more at ease there as well...
Why don't we go to the teacher's office?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You don't want to look around a bit more?
I want to talk with you alone.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're right, it's a bit too noisy here to have a serious conversation.
I lead the way toward the teachers' office.
Privaty follows behind me with a slightly dazed expression.
